decision.reasoning_trace: The browsing session was challenging as the feed contained several mis-categorized items like air mattresses, dog shirts, and patches. I focused on actual functional backpacks. In my consideration set, I included a specialized boot bag (prod_backpacks_186), a technical hiking daypack (prod_backpacks_043), two hydration packs (prod_backpacks_132, prod_backpacks_069), and a sling bag (prod_backpacks_168). I eventually chose prod_backpacks_132 because it has a massive volume of positive reviews (over 10,000) and a high rating of 4.6, suggesting it is a reliable and well-tested hydration backpack. The price point is competitive, and the insulation feature is highly praised in the reviews.
